description: This file defines email-sending functions for various billing and event-related notifications, utilizing imported email templates and external modules.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Utility function to send an email by executing a prepare function that returns a BaseEmail instance.

methods.name: eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail
methods.description: Checks if attendee emails are disabled for a given event type metadata.

methods.name: sendOrganizerPaymentRefundFailedEmail
methods.description: Sends refund failed emails to the organizer and team members for a specific calendar event.

methods.name: sendNoShowFeeChargedEmail
methods.description: Sends a no-show fee charged email to an attendee for a specific event, if attendee emails are enabled.

methods.name: sendCreditBalanceLowWarningEmails
methods.description: Sends low credit balance warning emails to team admins/owners and optionally to a user.

methods.name: sendCreditBalanceLimitReachedEmails
methods.description: Sends credit limit reached emails to team admins/owners and optionally to a user.

methods.name: sendProrationInvoiceEmails
methods.description: Sends proration invoice emails to team admins/owners, with error handling for failed sends.

methods.name: sendProrationReminderEmails
methods.description: Sends proration reminder emails to team admins/owners, with error handling for failed sends.
